description: Wrap a call to an interrupt-raising function in a handler that decides each effect differently. The idiomatic handler is one match on the effect name with a guard arm, not an if-chain; the holdout checks the decisions, the graders check the shape.

input.assignment: The file foo.agency in the working directory exports `foo(effect: string, dir: string = "."): Result<string>`. Depending on `effect`, foo raises one of the interrupts std::read, std::write, or std::email before returning; for std::read and std::write, the interrupt's data carries `dir`. Write a module that imports foo and exports `callFoo(effect: string, dir: string = "."): string`. callFoo must call foo inside a handler that approves std::read, approves std::write when the interrupt's dir is ".", rejects any other std::write with the message "only writes to the current directory are allowed", and rejects std::email with the message "email is never allowed". callFoo returns "approved" when foo succeeded and "rejected: " followed by the error when it was rejected. Use only Agency standard library (std::) imports, or no imports at all.
